Maybe Testimony 3: "I took my sister to the Channeling Chamber." Evidence 6: Newspaper clipping says Mimi (sister) died in car accident, not present. But that doesn't contradict taking her there.

Testimony 4: "I didn't see anyone on the way to the Channeling Chamber." Evidence 12/13 show Maya Fey present at scene after gunshot, but that is after they break into Chamber, not on way. Not contradiction.

Maybe evidence 12: Photo shows Maya Fey after they break into Chamber when they hear a gunshot. That suggests someone else (Maya) was there, contradicting Ini's claim she didn't see anyone on the way. But she says she didn't see anyone on the way, not at the chamber. Could still be okay.

But evidence 12 shows Maya present at the scene (Channeling Chamber) after gunshot. That doesn't contradict "didn't see anyone on the way". She could have not seen anyone until after entering.

Maybe evidence 0: Attorney's Badge shows defense attorney, but no testimony about being attorney.

Testimony 2: "I persuaded my sister it wasn't right to do something like that." Not contradictory.

Maybe evidence 1: Guidemap says side room east, have to go through winding path from meditation room to get to side room. Testimony 0 says side room was dark. Not contradictory.

Testimony 3: "I took my sister to the Channeling Chamber." Evidence 6: Newspaper clipping says Mimi (sister) died in car accident, not present. But Ini's sister is Mimi, who died a year ago. So Ini couldn't have taken her sister to Chamber because she is dead. That is a contradiction: Testimony says she took her sister (Mimi) to Channeling Chamber, but evidence says Mimi died in car accident a year ago. So evidence 6 contradicts testimony 3.

Thus answer pair: evidence 6, testimony 3.
